title: Review of c33's phoretic division (SID): replicates on fresh seeds 2 and 3 (labkit 7 and 10 persistent splits, generation 3; particle lineage on seed 2: 14 persistent splits to generation 6 by t=400, 13 of 14 leaving B in both daughters, by the B-band route), but the no-turnover twin is not division-free on seed 2 (5 persistent splits, generation 2 by particles; labkit 5, generation 5), while on seed 3 it gives 0
summary: c33's world, t=0-400, from the uniform random mix. Labkit with turnover: seed 2 17 splits / 33 merges, 7 persistent, generation 3; seed 3 36 / 49, 10 persistent, generation 3. No-turnover twin at the steady-state counts (NA 1300, NB 250, NF 250, all rates 0): seed 2 7 / 28, 5 persistent, labkit generation 5; seed 3 0 / 25, 0 persistent. c33's lineage.py on seed 2 (particle identity, hold 40): with turnover 41 splits, 77 merges, 14 persistent, max generation 6, 13 of 14 with B in both daughters, median daughters 56 and 94 particles; without turnover 17 splits, 67 merges, 5 persistent, max generation 2. deep_splits_seed2.png shows generation 4-6 splits: a B band between two A lobes thins and the lobes separate, each keeping B.

observations.S: particles_seed2.png t=0: uniform random mix of A, B and food
observations.D: deep_splits_seed2.png: generation 4-6 splits by the B-band route; lineage_seed2.txt 14 persistent splits to generation 6

seeds_run.result: pass with turnover (14 persistent splits, gen 6 by particles); twin not division-free (5, gen 2)
pass: labkit 10 persistent splits vs 0 in the twin

controls_run.D: tpack_off (turnover off at steady-state counts) on seeds 2 and 3; particle lineage of the twin on seed 2 (lineage_seed2.txt)

verdicts.limitation: Division is reticulate (merges about twice splits), daughters unequal, and the turnover-off twin also divides on seed 2 (5 persistent splits, generation 2), so turnover raises division depth (generation 6 vs 2) rather than creating division from nothing on every seed. The ledger reactions are designed proximity rules. No dt/2 here.
